spec_match.rationale: Uses the real EventTrigger + AnimationTrigger.addAnimation(animation, 'play-forwards' | 'replay') surface from Chromium's event_trigger.idl/animation_trigger.idl; the rewind check reads Animation.currentTime before and after the trigger listener runs. Matches the spec action table (play-forwards: play() on finished, no rewind; replay: set progress to 0).

interactive.rationale: Two pads driven by real pointerdown or keydown (selectable), a synthetic burst button, reset, live progress, readouts and a per-event rewind log.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Delivers the ChromeStatus press/release motivation and says plainly that release is script because Chrome 158 allows one trigger per animation and ignores EventTrigger deactivate.

edge_cases.rationale: Live checks cover finished play-forwards, replay contrast, second-trigger NotSupportedError, missing eventType TypeError, ignored deactivate action and the absent CSS event-trigger property; mid-release press resumes rather than rewinds.

references.rationale: ChromeStatus id link, spec action table and event-trigger sections, Chromium animation_trigger.cc / event_trigger.cc, launch bug.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite (AnimationTrigger global, animation-trigger property) is shown by the shared panel; no assertion edited.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome for Testing 158.0.8127.36 headless via Playwright (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud environment), with --enable-blink-features=EventTrigger and without it, desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch, 2026-11-25: trusted mouse press, hold, release and mid-release press, touch taps, keyboard Space hold with auto-repeat, burst and reset all exercised; finished play-forwards stayed at 600ms, replay rewound to 0ms; console and network clean. Real Android touch not verified.

telemetry_health.rationale: support('EventTrigger', supported|flag), assert play-forwards-finished-no-rewind after each repeated press, and assert the disabled fallback.

design_system.rationale: Design-system variables only; ivory text on accent-blue and accent-rose pads, rose only on light surfaces for REWOUND rows.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons and radio fieldset/legend, keyboard mode with Space/Enter, visible :focus-visible ring, polite status readouts, progress elements with aria-label. Accessibility tree not inspected with chrome-devtools-mcp (unavailable).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Zero horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800; lanes stack on mobile; pads 104px, buttons 44px min; long-press context menu suppressed and touch-action: manipulation on pads.

openQuestions.title: Replace script release with a native trigger once Chromium supports it
openQuestions.detail: When EventTrigger honours its deactivate action (crbug.com/441908430) or a CSS event-trigger property with pointerdown() / pointerup() lands, add the native release path as a new lane and keep this one.

openQuestions.title: Verify on a real Android device
openQuestions.detail: Touch was emulated by Playwright; confirm long-press does not open a context menu or select text, and pointercancel on scroll releases the pad.

guidanceConsulted.query: press and hold button feedback animation pointerdown pointerup keyboard accessible
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give every control press and focus feedback, use :focus-visible rings with 3:1 contrast, keep actions reachable without a mouse.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Pads are native buttons with a 3px text-black focus-visible ring; keyboard mode drives the same triggers with keydown/keyup.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Keyboard Space hold produced keydown + 3 repeat activations and keyup released the pad at 360x740 and 1280x800.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Animate transform properties on the compositor and adjust parameters under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce rather than zeroing durations.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Animates the individual scale property; under reduce the swell is 1 -> 1.08 with the same 600ms duration so the trigger state is still observable.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Keyframes use scale only; reduce branch checked in source.

summary: New experiment for the ChromeStatus press/release use case on the real EventTrigger interface, with honest limits: release is script in Chrome 158.
